direction: Contemporary Indonesian tropical modernism with restrained original sky-infrastructure expression
systems: Recessed imported window frames and modeled glazing/interior depth
Integrated planter edges and accessible entries
Expressive folded/shell roofs with visible structural ribs

prototypes.name: Ruang Niaga
prototypes.design: Three-storey terracotta and mineral shop building with a shaded arcade, a recessed corner entrance and planted upper terraces

site.reason: Move north of the reserved eastern clearing to retain the existing cross-trail
site.adaptation: Stepped stone base and short entrance stair/ramp; preserve terrain

prototypes.name: Atlas Research Centre
prototypes.design: Four-storey stepped sage research pavilion with a glazed observation atrium, vertical shading and open rooftop instrument terrace

site.reason: Eastern shoulder varies about 1.8 m across the initial envelope, without existing trail overlap; avoids occupying the Crown Ridge trail/viewpoint
site.adaptation: Piers and local entrance landing; a new uphill access route is conditional future work

prototypes.name: Stasiun Antara
prototypes.design: Open elevated passenger platform with a split butterfly roof, branching structural supports, visible rail bed and legible stair/elevator entrance

site.reason: Keep the reserved valley station location; a viaduct leaves the trail junction open below
site.adaptation: Variable-length foundation piers across the measured 6 m ground range, an elevated platform and separate stair/elevator core

prototypes.name: Pelabuhan Awan
prototypes.design: Cloud-facing terminal with an asymmetrical ribbed wing roof, protected boarding lounge and a circular landing apron

site.reason: Shift south of the arrival reservation to face the open cloudscape and connect back to the existing approach
site.adaptation: Raised continuous deck on piers over roughly 2.3 m of terrain change, with northern approach ramp

sourceDecision: Use individual Kenney Modular Buildings 2.1 and Building Kit 1.0 components after raw 3D inspection. Do not use their sample buildings or any rejected Jakarta prototype.
productionIsolation: Dedicated review page only. Home/Work and all approved landscape source files remain unchanged.
